title: A Novel TLR4 Inhibitor DB03476 Rescued Renal Inflammation in Acute Kidney Injury Model.
authors: Zhang, Yi-Fan; Ma, Yu-Xuan; Wei, Shi-Jie; Yang, Bo; Ji, Yun-Hua; Qi, Zheng-Xiang; Shi, Xin-Yu; Zhang, Long-Long; Fan, Xiao-Zheng; Yang, Xiao-Jian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TLR4小分子抑制剂DB03476在急性肾损伤中的抗炎作用，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法用于结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a critical clinical syndrome characterized by a rapid decline in renal function, frequently resulting from ischemia, nephrotoxicity, or sepsis. It represents a major global health burden due to its high morbidity and mortality and its strong association with progression to chronic kidney disease. In this study, we identified a novel small-molecule TLR4 inhibitor, DB03476, via structure-based virtual screening targeting the intracellular TIR domain of murine Tlr4. Molecular dynamics simulations confirmed that DB03476 stabilizes Tlr4 without altering its global conformation. In a murine ischemia-reperfusion-induced AKI model, DB03476 administration significantly attenuated renal inflammation, macrophage infiltration, and apoptosis and suppressed the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway. Moreover, DB03476 exhibited cross-species efficacy by binding conserved residues in human TLR4 with high affinity. Functional validation using human kidney organoids confirmed its protective effects against inflammatory challenge. These results demonstrate DB03476 as a promising therapeutic agent for AKI through selective inhibition of TLR4-mediated inflammatory responses.
abstract_zh: 急性肾损伤（acute kidney injury, AKI）是一种以肾功能快速下降为特征的危重临床综合征，常由缺血、肾毒性或脓毒症引起。由于其高发病率和死亡率，以及与慢性肾病进展的密切关联，它构成了重大的全球健康负担。在本研究中，我们通过基于结构的虚拟筛选，针对小鼠Tlr4的胞内TIR结构域，鉴定了一种新型小分子TLR4抑制剂DB03476。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟证实，DB03476能稳定Tlr4而不改变其整体构象。在鼠缺血-再灌注诱导的AKI模型中，DB03476给药显著减轻了肾脏炎症、巨噬细胞浸润和凋亡，并抑制了TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB通路。此外，DB03476通过高亲和力结合人TLR4中的保守残基，表现出跨物种效力。使用人肾类器官的功能验证确认了其对炎症挑战的保护作用。这些结果表明，DB03476通过选择性抑制TLR4介导的炎症反应，是AKI的一种有前景的治疗药物。
